objective_success_bonus: float, +100 if both legs contact ground, |x|<0.1, |y|<0.1, |vy|<0.1, |angle|<0.1
crash_penalty: float, -100 if terminated and not success
descending_progress_bonus: float, +1.0 * max(0, previous_y - y) where previous_y is stored in self.last_y, initialized to state[1] at first step
hovering_penalty: float, -0.1 if speed<0.1 and not leg_contact and not terminated
stable_idle_bonus: float, +0.05 if action==0 and speed<0.1 and |angle|<0.1 and not leg_contact and not terminated
